Commit the change with a clear message before reporting done.

Do not change harness enforcement (that landed in the prerequisite task).

edge_cases: An absent [sandbox.limits] section decomposes to max_cost_usd=0.0 (unenforced).

A configured [sandbox.limits] max_cost_usd reaches HarnessConfig so the harness enforcement (prerequisite task) caps the run.
